prompt: Create an original 60 second cool jazz instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: muted trumpet, vibraphone, double bass, brushes. Style: spare melodic answers, extended chords and unhurried swing. Tempo approximately 94 BPM; C major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and playful big band jazz piece featuring prominent brass and woodwind melodies over a swinging rhythm section. The arrangement is dynamic with call-and-response sections and a clear, bright sound.
description.zh: 一首活泼俏皮的大乐队爵士乐曲，以突出的铜管和木管旋律为主，配以摇摆的节奏部分。编曲充满活力，有呼应段落，音色清晰明亮。
